extra.reason: Implemented for real: src/sprite/tools/generate-arcade-topdown-set.ts, registered in src/sprite/tools/index.ts and src/tools/index.ts (images-assets, appended at end per convention). Preset wrapper: symmetric_rotation_safe true (default) delegates to the same enqueueSpriteJob path as generate_sprite for one canonical frame with viewpoint forced to topdown; false delegates to runAnimationSet (same engine as generate_animation_set) with motion_states required. Reuses generate-sprite.ts/generate-animation-set.ts validators and formatters (exported for that purpose) instead of duplicating them. Covered by src/__tests__/tools/generate-arcade-topdown-set.test.ts (7 tests). Full suite: 170 files / 1992 tests passing, tsc build clean.

Implemented: src/sprite/tools/export-for-engine.ts (registered in src/sprite/tools/index.ts + src/tools/index.ts, images-assets, appended at end). Takes the exact SpritesheetMetadata object pack_spritesheet returns plus the sheet PNG (asset_id/path via image-io.ts), validates it as a boundary (src/sprite/export/validate-metadata.ts: frame_count/frames.length agreement, rects within sheet bounds, sheet-image dimensions match metadata), and translates to Unity's bottom-left/y-up rect convention in the pure src/sprite/export/unity.ts (engine_y = sheet_height - y - height; pivot passes through unchanged). engine is schema-advertised as unity/godot/gamemaker but assertImplementedExportEngine (src/sprite/types.ts) rejects godot/gamemaker before any image load or file write -- never a silent no-op, same pattern as consistency_mode's controlnet_pose rejection. Writes PNG + sibling .json to out_path, or returns both inline. Covered by src/__tests__/tools/export-for-engine.test.ts (12 tests, real sharp-encoded fixture sheet, no mocked image decoding). Full suite: 171 files / 2004 tests passing, tsc build + lint clean.

pixelate_image: HTTP fallback for relative path reads without COMFYUI_PATH, save_dir on pixelate_image/export_for_engine, asset registration via registerLocal(). 2032 tests passing.

remove_background: added mode luma_key (comfy-core-only luminance key: LoadImage -> 3x ImageToMask -> 2x MaskComposite(add) -> [ThresholdMask] -> [GrowMask] -> InvertMask -> JoinImageWithAlpha -> SaveImage), with optional threshold/softness. Verified structurally via validate_workflow and end-to-end against live ComfyUI (hollow-center test: background+hollow center alpha=0, ring alpha=255 -- exact BiRefNet failure mode fixed). 2039 tests passing.

Wired unconditional validateWorkflow(workflow, {health:false}) into enqueueSpriteJob right before submit (sprite-job.ts) -- both generate_sprite and generate_animation_set funnel through it. A malformed/missing-model graph is now caught before hitting ComfyUI instead of failing async at runtime.

Added auto_download_missing (explicit opt-in, default false) to generate_sprite/generate_animation_set. On validation failure due to missing model(s), resolves the best CivitAI/HuggingFace candidate (liveResolveDeps, refactored out of resolve_missing_models into services/missing-models.ts), downloads it via downloadModel/resolveCivitaiModel(Version), rewires the workflow to the actually-installed filename, resets the client-side object_info cache, and re-validates before enqueue. No candidate found -> actionable error, never a broken checkpoint. Reports downloaded_models in both tools' results. LoRA wiring (7dc.1) explicitly out of scope. 12 new unit tests (sprite-job.test.ts) + 3 propagation tests (generate-animation-set.test.ts). Full suite: 175 files / 2054 tests passing.
